title: Synthetic Speech, Real Signal: Paralinguistic Preservation and Cross-Lingual Augmentation via Voice Cloning
abstract: arXiv:2607.22304v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Synthetic data augmentation in speech is common practice for linguistic tasks like ASR, but has seen far less work for paralinguistic ones, especially clinical tasks where labelled data is expensive and some patient groups are underrepresented. Voice cloning is one such augmentation approach, but is typically evaluated on speech intelligibility (WER) or speaker similarity (SS) rather than on downstream performance, and it remains unclear whether these preserve the paralinguistic signal such tasks depend on. We benchmark eight voice cloning models on five paralinguistic tasks across public and clinical datasets, showing most preserve signal with modest degradation. translated_title: 合成语音，真实信号：通过语音克隆实现副语言信息保留与跨语言数据增强
translated_abstract: 语音中的合成数据增强在ASR等语言学任务中已是常见做法，但在副语言任务中的研究却少得多，尤其是临床任务，因为其标注数据昂贵且某些患者群体代表性不足。语音克隆是一种此类增强方法，但通常仅通过语音可懂度（WER）或说话人相似度（SS）来评估，而非基于下游任务性能，目前尚不清楚这些方法能否保留此类任务所依赖的副语言信号。我们在公开和临床数据集上，对八个语音克隆模型在五个副语言任务上进行了基准测试，结果表明大多数模型能保留副语言信号，仅有轻微性能退化。随后，我们将英语临床语音克隆为日语，发现使用克隆数据训练在真实日语语音上的抑郁和焦虑检测性能优于直接的跨语言迁移，这表明语音克隆是增强临床语音数据的一个有前景的方向。
tldr: 该论文系统评估了八个语音克隆模型对副语言信号的保留能力，并证明将英语临床语音克隆为日语后进行训练，在真实日语语音的抑郁和焦虑检测上优于直接的跨语言迁移。
en_tdlr: This paper benchmarks eight voice cloning models on paralinguistic tasks, showing most preserve paralinguistic signals with modest degradation, and demonstrates that training on cloned English-to-Japanese clinical speech outperforms raw cross-lingual transfer for depression and anxiety detection on real Japanese speech.
